goal: Verify that a user can create a new Site Host account, navigate to the June 2026 calendar view, and successfully switch to the previous year (2025) using the calendar navigation controls.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in, locate the calendar widget and click the button labeled 'June 2026' to open the full-year calendar view for 2026.
In the top-right corner of the 2026 calendar view, click the left-pointing arrow button (labeled 'Previous year') to navigate to the previous year.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the signup page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar view displays the full year '2026' with the month of June highlighted or selected.
After clicking the previous year button, the calendar header updates to display '2025'.
The calendar grid correctly renders the months and dates for the year 2025.
No error messages or loading failures appear during the account creation or calendar navigation steps.
